caveats: Native cell-zone tank volume is used instead of ideal CAD tank capacity; CAD capacity differs by ~5.25 L/tank.
The initial wet prefix is set by the assumed x=2.25 m seat; centerline-area integral is compared with native wetted-feed inventory and is not forced by rescaling.
Transition areas use sparse current CAD BREP normal-section samples at five discrete locations and piecewise linear interpolation. No continuous area profile/minimum is asserted.
The intermediate BREP section normal is oblique to the ruled loft station plane; hydraulic diameter is an equivalent 4A/P estimate for assumed rectangles, linearly interpolated.
Tank-side intake crown remains a projected-section estimate from the matching generated centerline, not a measured physical lip.
Branches use provisional CAD assumptions, not manufacturing measurements; moving-front assumes full-bore liquid and ambient front pressure.
coordinate_frame: SI; +X discharge, +Z up; Tank A y=-0.55 m; one tank / lower and upper branches.

join_volume_change.scope: BREP outside-tank line volume; not a measured CFD inventory.

model_scope: One tank / two separate lower-upper branches represents tank A only; no exact two-tank/four-outlet coupling.

native_zone_and_reduced_profile_comparis.limitations: Native mesh zone volumes are available, but no native centerline integral of ds/A is asserted. The one-dimensional inertance values are derived from this sampled centerline and the packet area profile.

profile.area_interpolation: Linear in centerline arclength between sparse exact BREP section samples; pipe is analytic circular area before x=3.8.

centerline_samples.coordinate_representation: Direct current compact CAD-generator x,y,z coordinates; 3D polyline arclength is recomputed from rows.
centerline_samples.interpretation: A sampled provisional centerline, not a measured centerline or exact watertight CAD medial axis.

hydraulic_diameter_profile.basis: round pipe ID followed by 4A/P for assumed rectangular transition sections; linearly interpolated as an equivalent-loss diameter

lamella_treatment.area_used_by_reduced_model: Gross envelope section area, consistent with zero geometric-volume blockage.
lamella_treatment.current_CFD_wall_model: Zero-thickness wall mid-surfaces; finite 4 mm display solids are not used as flow blockage.
lamella_treatment.friction_limit: The equivalent hydraulic-diameter profile is based on assumed rectangular sections and does not add the zero-thickness divider surfaces to wetted perimeter; downstream lamella friction is therefore not represented exactly.

purpose: Current flush-at-inlet geometry-derived 1-D reference inputs; no CFD-flow fitting.
qualification_additions: The current CFD boundary contains zero-thickness lamellaMaster/lamellaSlave wall surfaces. Gross section areas are retained because these walls have no modeled solid thickness; finite 4 mm CAD display solids are not used for CFD blockage.
The reduced hydraulic-diameter estimate does not yet include added lamella wetted perimeter, so line friction through the divided transition is an equivalent-line approximation.
The model is one representative Tank A with its distinct lower and upper branches. It is not an exact symmetric two-tank/four-branch network.
source_centerline: Current scripts/i4f_four_outlet_geometry/generate.py branch_pipe Bezier/straight spine sampled along arclength; transition centerline follows current ruled loft stations.
